title: Simple Four-Piece Place Setting
description: Original four-piece static place-setting family: a shallow rimmed ceramic plate, four-tine fork, blunt shouldered table knife and shallow eating spoon. Four independently selectable closed mesh nodes with local bottom-center origins and unit scale. Two fixed arrangements on existing table and service counter are checked against actual support faces, utensil and mug geometry, with an over-edge negative test. Existing furniture and mugs are separate reused assets. No stacking, mechanism, washing or food-safety claim.
